item.title: Jasmine Crockett defends her security guard who was killed in police standoff, wanted for impersonating cop
item.summary: Rep. Jasmine Crockett's security guard killed in a SWAT standoff was accused of impersonating police, and the congresswoman defended him despite his lengthy rap sheet.
